verses.1: Go, and return to the LORD. For He is the one who can heal us and restore us to health.
verses.2: May they be saved from this world on the third day. Then we will rise and live before Him.
verses.3: And we will know that He is being pursued by those who seek to know Him. When He returns from His exile, He will come to us as a savior who will redeem us from the oppression of this land.
verses.4: What shall I do for you, Ephraim? What shall I do for you, Judah? Your mercy is like the clouds in the evening, and like the stars that shine brightly.
verses.5: Therefore, I have made the prophets who kill people by their own words and judgments.
verses.6: For I desire mercy, but not sacrifice; and I have knowledge of God’s ways.
verses.7: And these people, like any other human beings, made a covenant there. They broke that covenant.
verses.8: Gilad is the son of Peleh, who was related to Awn.
verses.9: And those who are arrogant and proud, they become like enemies. They act in a way that leads to murder. This is because they have sinned.
verses.10: In the house of Israel, I saw a place where prostitution took place. It was a grave for the Israelites.
verses.11: Also, Judah has harvested for you again, in my time of rest.
